## History

Frank Stockley was a student whose uncle served on the board of governors. During his time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), he shared this information with a classmate as their group of ambitious friends prepared for their spring examinations.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV.
